node.title: Official-row low-square-mass E1 collision-graph coloring
node.statement: For every pair-feasible prime-field row at the six named RowC/prize envelopes, prove that the graph of same-reduced-E1 class pairs with S<=2ell has chromatic number at most its exact row cap: 3268165922105543787, 210, 18885148505476, 54730211038721500, 3, or 316259390691 respectively. The binding prize rate-1/8 row asks for chi<=3 on N=256,ell=33,S<=66. By the proved Plotkin compiler this supplies more than B* distinct values without proving injectivity or the separate P allowance.
node.attack_surface: construct a three-color invariant or degree-two theorem on the binding row; otherwise exhibit an exact four-chromatic low-mass collision subgraph
node.falsifier: an admissible row with certified chromatic number above its printed cap, including a same-fiber low-mass K4 on the binding row
